trade-sell.title: Stored goods sold where a station bid stands: each ship sells its own stores, nothing bought
trade-sell.note: Every route is gated by requires.stored (the pilot's own storage) and requires.bid (a book read within the hour at the floor); a run sells only what the bid takes. Soma floor 340 (Central Nexus asks 293 in depth); hydrogen floor 30 (Ironlight asks 6 in depth); palladium floor 300 (base value 200; Sirius asks 432). Routes written by sellgen.py of the trade-books skill. Open to every division's ships (rule F24). Starter hull, no module needed.

trade-craft.title: Crafting from the pilot's own stores: steel and copper piping for the reserve, focused crystal for sale
trade-craft.note: 2026-11-17 11:40 UTC (Mercury, orders ENT-036): the two craft-piping routes lead: they turn stored copper ore, which no station bids for, and stored iron into copper piping and steel plate for the reserve; then the focused crystal for sale and Logistics' three steel crafts.

trade-train-nav.title: Navigation trained to 3 on a loop of our five stations, for Signal Fragments (7,000 cr once)
trade-train-nav.note: requires.skills_below navigation 3: the route closes by itself at navigation 3, and Signal Fragments in the list First takes the pilot. About 4 navigation XP a jump, a loop of 17 to 18 minutes for about 165 cr of fuel.

trade-gas.title: Gas harvested and sold into the Node Beta and Central Nexus gas bids
trade-gas.note: Needs a Gas Harvester I. One ship a route: the hydrogen and plasma bids take a few dozen units an hour; the loss stop closes a route whose last runs lost.

trade-gather.title: Fallback: iron ore gathered into storage for the reserve when no trade or craft is open
trade-gather.note: 2026-11-17 11:44 UTC (Mercury, orders ENT-036): gather-okab-belt leads, a one-ship test beyond the border with lift_to 8, while every home field of this list stands at its floor; its iron and copper go into Node Beta storage for craft-piping-node-beta.
